spanish: Y si estas tres no hace a ella, y saldrá gratis, no hay plata.

findings.issue: וְיָצְאָה is qal sequential perfect 3rd feminine singular, so the woman goes out. Unmarked "saldrá" continues the 3rd-masculine subject of "hace".
שְׁלָשׁ אֵלֶּה is the object of 3ms יַעֲשֶׂה. Fronted "estas tres" sits in the subject slot before "hace"; the singular verb still encodes a 3ms doer.

notes: Y si, a ella, gratis, and no hay plata match וְאִם, לָהּ, חִנָּם, and אֵין כָּסֶף.
